name: Williams Companies
description: Williams owns natural gas pipelines and gathering and processing plants. Its Transco system is the main long-haul pipeline carrying gas from Gulf and Appalachian supply to East Coast and Southeast users, and it is paid mostly regulated, fee-based reservation charges for capacity whether or not gas flows. It also gathers and processes gas in the Northeast, Rockies, Haynesville and Eagle Ford, and runs a smaller gas and NGL marketing arm that does earn commodity margins. FY2025 revenue was $11,950M and net income attributable to Williams $2,618M.

employees.note: Full-time employees, all in the United States.

businessLines.name: Transmission, Power & Gulf
businessLines.how: Fees for reserved capacity on Transco, Northwest Pipeline and other regulated gas pipelines (rates set by FERC), plus Gulf offshore gathering and platform service fees and a growing power-innovation business selling committed onsite power.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 Modified EBITDA (the segment profit measure the 10-K reports)

businessLines.name: Northeast G&P
businessLines.how: Fee-based gathering, processing and compression for Appalachian gas producers, much of it under long-term contracts, with a large share of earnings from equity-method joint ventures (Proportional Modified EBITDA of equity-method investments $640M).

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 Modified EBITDA (the segment profit measure the 10-K reports)

businessLines.name: West
businessLines.how: Fees for gathering, processing and transporting gas and NGLs in the Rockies, Haynesville and Eagle Ford, with some commodity consideration (NGLs taken as payment under keep-whole and percent-of-liquids contracts).

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 Modified EBITDA (the segment profit measure the 10-K reports)

businessLines.name: Gas & NGL Marketing Services
businessLines.how: Buys and sells gas and NGLs and holds transport and storage capacity; earns commodity margins ($226M in 2025) and is swung by unrealised gains and losses on derivatives.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 Modified EBITDA (the segment profit measure the 10-K reports)

brands.name: Transco (Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line)
brands.note: Largest regulated pipeline; design capacity about 20.6 MMdth/d with 62 compressor stations at 2025-12-31. A general rate case was filed with FERC on 2024-08-30.

brands.name: Discovery Producer Services
brands.note: Remaining 40 percent acquired 2024-08-01 and consolidated (Gulf of America gathering).
